episodes.name: collision_during_approach
episodes.description: Arm hits an unmodeled obstacle mid-approach: force spike and stop.

episodes.name: stall_during_approach
episodes.description: Policy keeps commanding motion but the arm does not move (no contact force).

episodes.name: slip_during_transport
episodes.description: Object slides out of the fingers while being carried.

episodes.name: singularity_during_transport
episodes.description: Arm drives toward a joint limit; joint speeds spike.

episodes.name: drop_during_lift
episodes.description: Object falls out of the gripper right after lift-off.
